name: Kosmos-382
about: Kosmos-382 (1970-103A), a crewed vehicle (L-1e), launched 1970 Dec  2. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (AO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1971 Jan  1), held fixed

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
